I had those infest my car. Sucked like hell.

They don't sting and they are tiny, almost like sugar ants, but they come by the billions and they infest just about anything. They crawled up my tires and made a nest somewhere in the weather stripping of my car. Every time I started to drive the vibration would send them scurrying. I would use ant poison and bait, which worked, but a week later they would be back. Finally started just keeping ant bait in my floor boards 24-7, after a month they never came back. Car was kept clean.

I'm no fan of fire ants, they carry staph and a friend had half his foot removed because of a fire ant bite. But these guys are just plain annoying.
